record.original_question: Let X be a hyperkahler manifold of dimension 2r. If L is a nontrivial nef line bundle on X with Beauville-Bogomolov square q(L) = 0, determine whether there must exist a Lagrangian fibration f: X -> P^r such that L = f^* O_{P^r}(k) for some integer k >= 1. More generally, determine whether X is birational to a hyperkahler manifold X' admitting a Lagrangian fibration X' -> P^r exactly when X carries a nontrivial line bundle L with q(L) = 0.

evidence.quote: The analogue of this notion when X is compact (hence hyperkahler) is a Lagrangian fibration X -> P^r.
Conjecture 2. a) Let L be a nontrivial nef line bundle on X with q(L) = 0. There exists a Lagrangian fibration f : X -> P^r such that L = f^* O_{P^r}(k) for some k >= 1.
b) There exists a hyperkahler manifold X' bimeromorphic to X and a Lagrangian fibration X' -> P^r if and only if X admits a line bundle L != O_S with q(L) = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact hyperkähler (irreducible holomorphic symplectic) manifold of complex dimension $2r$, and let $q$ denote the Beauville–Bogomolov–Fujiki quadratic form on $H^2(X,\mathbb{Z})$. Recall that a surjective holomorphic map $f:X\to B$ with connected fibers onto a normal base $B$ of dimension $r$ is called a Lagrangian fibration if its general fiber is a Lagrangian complex torus; in this situation Matsushita's theorem implies $B\cong \mathbb{P}^r$ when $X$ is projective and $B$ is smooth.

(a) Suppose $L$ is a nontrivial nef line bundle on $X$ with $q(L)=0$. Prove or disprove: there must exist a Lagrangian fibration $f:X\to \mathbb{P}^r$ and an integer $k\geq 1$ such that $L\cong f^*\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^r}(k)$.

(b) More generally, prove or disprove: $X$ is bimeromorphic to a compact hyperkähler manifold $X'$ admitting a Lagrangian fibration $X'\to \mathbb{P}^r$ if and only if $X$ carries a nontrivial line bundle $L$ with $q(L)=0$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Hyperkähler SYZ / Beauville–Huybrechts–Sawon–Tyurin Lagrangian fibration conjecture. It remains open in general. It has been verified in all currently known deformation classes for specific examples and under various restrictions (e.g., Matsushita's results, Markman and Bayer–Macrì for $K3^{[n]}$-type, and analogous statements for generalized Kummer, OG6, OG10 in many cases). Verbitsky proved that nef line bundles with $q(L)=0$ are semipositive in suitable senses, and recent work (e.g., 2024–2025 preprints) addresses the conjecture in families and via abundance, but the full conjecture has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Hyperkähler SYZ conjecture and semipositive line bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Verbitsky's work establishing semipositivity of nef line bundles with q(L)=0, a step toward the SYZ conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is partially supported by semipositivity results but remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Lagrangian fibrations on hyperkähler manifolds — On a question of Beauville
status_evidence.snippet: Markman addresses Beauville's question for K3^[n]-type hyperkähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture has been verified for the K3^[n] deformation class under Markman's results.

status_evidence.title: The abundance and SYZ conjectures in families of hyperkähler manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work studying the SYZ conjecture in families.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture continues to be actively investigated and is not fully resolved.
